root_cause.text: In the VFE interrupt handler (vfe_isr), the loop that checks RDI register update status uses MSM_VFE_IMAGE_MASTERS_NUM (7) as the upper bound, but the vfe->line array is defined with size VFE_LINE_NUM_MAX (4), causing out-of-bounds memory access when the loop index is 4, 5, or 6.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and patch commit message explicitly state: "vfe_isr() iterates using MSM_VFE_IMAGE_MASTERS_NUM(7) as the loop bound and passes the index to vfe_isr_reg_update(). However, vfe->line[] array is defined with VFE_LINE_NUM_MAX(4) ... When index is 4, 5, 6, the access to vfe->line[line_id] exceeds the array bounds." The patch diff separates the loop into two iterations: one for output lines (up to MAX_VFE_OUTPUT_LINES) and another for write masters (up to MSM_VFE_IMAGE_MASTERS_NUM).
